Jon Rosenthal

Democratic candidate for Railroad Commissioner, Texas

Texas state representative (HD 135, D-Houston); engineer who worked in the oil and gas industry

Jon Rosenthal is a Democratic state representative from Northwest Houston who worked about 25 years as an engineer in and around the oil and gas industry. He was unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for Texas Railroad Commissioner. In the November 3, 2026 general election he faces Republican Bo French and Libertarian Arthur DiBianca for an open seat.

Background

  • Texas House of Representatives, member representing Northwest Houston (D-Houston); won the seat by defeating a Republican incumbent
  • Engineer; worked in and around the oil and gas industry for about 25 years
  • Founded a grassroots political group after the 2016 presidential election
  • 2026 Democratic nominee for Texas Railroad Commissioner; unopposed in the March 3, 2026 primary
